cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The waiter put his hand up, so I've put mine up too. Stay a moment; I'll tell you when our coffee is officially over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He was checking the clock. I need to catch my bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, a time check. Sit down while I decide whether I can let you go early.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's pointing to the door now. They're closing; we both have to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then wait just outside for me. He can close the cafe; I'll finish dismissing you on the pavement.
